question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Into hot water
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"Into hot water"** means to get into trouble or a difficult situation. (मुसीबत में पड़ना)

 
 
• **Example: **He got into hot water for not completing his assignment on time.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.
